preventionRule: Deleting a branch or rewriting refs/heads/* does NOT remove a secret from a public repo: refs/pull/<N>/head pins the pre-rewrite commit forever. Treat any leaked secret as live until the key is rotated AND unreachable objects are purged server-side. Never treat push --delete, a history rewrite, or a 'heads are clean' scan as remediation.
